question_en: (Earlier exchange quoted in the thread, June 2025) Three licensed monohull skippers want a trainer from our side to get familiar with a catamaran before a bareboat charter.
answer_exact: Additionally, I would like to point out that our team does not include a trainer for this type of instruction. However, during the technical check-in at our pontoon, our staff will be more than happy to walk you through the key features and functions of the catamaran, which can be very helpful for your familiarization.

statement: Earlier 2025 offer (quoted in thread): Bali 4.0 'Vallejo' (2018 rebuilt 2020, 40 ft, 5 cabins), Lagoon 40 'Imeroessa' (2022, 39 ft, 5 cabins), Lagoon 42 'Idal' (2021, 42 ft, 6 cabins, 5 WC, water maker), all Lefkada.
2025 offer (quoted): security deposit Bali 4.0 3,500 EUR, Lagoon 40 4,000 EUR, Lagoon 42 4,000 EUR, with no skipper halving and no damage waiver line shown.

All bareboat offers carry the line 'Skipper licence required'. Our team does not provide a trainer for catamaran familiarisation; staff walk guests through the key features during technical check-in at our pontoon. Accepted licences (RYA, ICC and others): not found - please confirm.
